result.rationale: The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: in EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents the new code does `let credential = this.calendarCredentials.find(...)`; then only assigns credential if `credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug`, and only creates/pushes an event `if (credential)`. If both lookups fail, nothing is pushed to createdEvents and no failed EventResult or warning is recorded, so the destination calendar is silently skipped — plausible silent data-loss/skipped-event behavior introduced by this new DB-lookup path. Whether tolerating disconnected credentials was intentional is arg

judged_text: packages/core/EventManager.ts:356 — Advisory P2 confidence 75: `if (credentialFromDB && credentialFromDB.app?.slug)` followed by `if (credential)` silently omits a cohost's calendar when the newly introduced database lookup returns no usable credential, so booking consumers receive no failed result or warning; tolerating disconnected integrations is the strongest rebuttal, but toleration does not justify reporting only the other hosts' successes and hiding the skipped host from appsStatus.
